summary: Prepare RHEL VMs for automation mesh: SSH in, create an SSH key for hop-to-execution connections, and register with subscription-manager (register --auto-attach, or plain register with Simple Content Access); RHUI is not supported.
questions: How do I prepare a RHEL VM as an execution node?
